# 1.0.7 beta 2

This beta supersedes 1.0.7 beta 1 and remains newer than the stable 1.0.5 release.

- Added smooth, bounded mouse-wheel scrolling across every scrollable view. Discrete wheel input eases into position, repeated input accumulates without overshooting, and the container's real bounds are always respected.
- Preserved Avalonia's native path for touchpads, keyboard paging, scrollbar dragging and reduced-motion mode. Wheel easing is disabled when Reduced Motion is selected.
- Added consistent, theme-aware scrollbars with a clearer thumb, hover and pressed states, and an always-discoverable appearance without a heavy track.
- Improved nested scrolling so the area under the pointer owns the wheel gesture, parent pages stay put while a child scrolls, and chaining follows the child's configured boundary.
- Made the release picker scroll independently from the installer page, keep the selected version visible, and support Arrow, Page, Home and End navigation plus Escape.
- Logs are now selectable and copyable. New output follows automatically only while the reader is at the bottom; scrolling up stops following, and a localized **Latest** action returns to the newest output.
- Preserved scroll positions when returning from details, closing Settings, changing theme, language or UI scale, and expanding or collapsing page sections.
- Added bounded scrolling to long confirmation dialogs, the changelog, diagnostics and nested log views so they do not extend beyond their panels.
- Polished the Settings open/close transition, including interruption handling and reduced-motion support.
- Improved the release catalogue presentation and renamed pinned releases to **Older versions** across all ten interface languages.
- Added the higher-resolution Titanfall 2 hero artwork.
- Updated translations and the localization glossary for the new log and release labels.

Installation, Steam, WiVRn and version-catalogue selection behavior are unchanged.
